evidence: NOTE: R10 is faithful. The coverage contract identity and budget fields are grounded in retrieve_sources, which context already calls. Owner decision (one palimnex:explain-search:v1 document with sibling search and coverage) is unchanged. palimnex search parser and cache_commands dispatch are untouched. explain-search embeds retrieve_sources unchanged; probes confirmed search == retrieve_sources(...) and no mutation.

NOTE: R11 is a faithful correction of R9, not an unauthorized contract change. The 128 bound is on stored keys; coverage queries are 8 KiB UTF-8. Owner confirmation of R9 was the whitespace mapping (C* refused on keys; query isspace to U+0020 then steps 1-5). match_aliases now uses normalize_query without the alias length cap. 1014-character and 8192-byte queries match; 8193 bytes is query_bound; 200-character queries no longer hit alias_bound. Listed for the owner; integration ownership of palimnex/concepts.py is recorded in bundle-validation.r11.json.

NOTE: Default missing registry prints coverage_state registry_absent, coverage null, exit 0. Explicit missing registry, candidate_set, symlink path, absolute path, .., and backslash are typed refusals, exit 1, no document. CLI stderr is a non-echoing JSON error. Real-repo `explain-search 'concept registry' --limit 2` matched the explain-search schema.

NOTE: Secret canary in the query with an enabled registry is CoverageError query_privacy_refused with no echo. CLI canary plus missing --registry is registry_read_refused with no canary in stdout or stderr. retrieve_sources still runs locally before a later typed refusal when the path is otherwise admitted.

NOTE: palimnex.coverage is imported only inside explain_search (lazy) and tests. No ontology/concept-registry.v1.json was created. COMPATIBILITY, CHANGELOG, CONCEPT_REGISTRY, and pyproject.toml mypy files list are additive. --backend cache constructs RedisClient and does not fall back to local.

NOTE: No integration implementation receipt is present yet. Full suite, mypy-all, index, evaluate, palimnex_check.sh, and ledger-status were not run, as instructed. --backend cache was not exercised because Redis was not used.

source_grounding_result: explain_search loads an approved_registry via load_registry (bounded, nofollow, privacy-scanned) and builds a coverage receipt over the same retrieve_sources object it embeds. Checkout and project identity checks remain in coverage.py and concepts.py.
privacy_result: Refusals use CoverageError or ConceptRegistryError messages that contain reason and field only. CLI errors go to stderr as JSON status/error without the registry argument or query. Query secrets are not printed. When coverage is disabled, the raw query remains inside search, which is existing retrieve_sources behavior.
retrieval_quality_result: search is a deep copy of retrieve_sources. Flags mirror context: --limit default 5, --byte-budget default 8192, --backend local|cache, --no-graph, --registry. Ranking is unchanged. A query with more than 128 lexical terms still fails in retrieve_sources (pre-existing MAX_QUERY_TERMS); that is separate from the R11 alias-length fix.
compatibility_result: New command only. search, context v1, cache, ledger, MCP, and configuration are unchanged in the diff. Rollback is revert of the listed tracked files plus deletion of the new untracked explain-search test.
rollback_result: Revert palimnex/core.py, palimnex/concepts.py, palimnex/tests/test_concepts.py, docs/COMPATIBILITY.md, docs/CONCEPT_REGISTRY.md, palimnex/CHANGELOG.md, and pyproject.toml; delete palimnex/tests/test_explain_search.py. Phase 1 matching behavior returns to the 128-character query cap.
authority_result: Read-only command. No ranking influence, no approved registry created, no config key, no MCP tool, no ledger or cache write on the default local backend. Git writes were not performed.
limitations: Integration task-card acceptance commands that need sockets (full suite, palimnex_check.sh, index, evaluate) were skipped as instructed.
